description.value: The Lighthouse Motel is an oceanfront motel in Qualicum Bay on Vancouver Island, with views across the Strait of Georgia to Hornby Island and the snow-capped Coastal Mountains. The property sits on the West Island Highway and promotes itself as a year-round base for exploring the area. Nearby cycling routes listed on the website include the Lighthouse Country Trail (15.8 km) and mountain bike trails, with ferry access to Denman and Hornby Islands about 8.7 km away.

address.value: 6035 Island Hwy W, Qualicum Bay, BC V9K 2E1
